analysis.reading:
A CARD DATED SEVEN DAYS BEFORE THE TERMINATION. Card 4 is the archive’s Zenodo community page, and the snippet Google chose to represent it is a SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE NOTICE: "Planned intervention: On Thursday April 23rd 06:30 UTC Zenodo will be unavailable for 20-30 minutes to perform a storage cluster…". Captured 12 June 2026. On 19 June the account was removed and the community page went with it. The last composed description of the archive’s Zenodo presence is an announcement of a twenty-minute outage.

Card 3 also carries the sentence that states the project’s material basis: "500+ DOI-anchored deposits on CERN’s Zenodo, built from a TEACHING SALARY over ten [years]". Card 7 bylines THE SPACE ARK to "Jack Feist / Lee Sharks" — the heteronym first. The one clean collision is Wikipedia on interstellar arks.
